component tests: each renders its component with literal props and content to assert behaviour, and none is product UI
ignore.packages/components/tests/a11y.test.tsx: the accessibility gate: it renders every component story under axe, so it is a test harness and not product UI
ignore.packages/undrift/templates/missing.tsx: the Missing placeholder that undrift init copies into an adopter's repo: it hardcodes the magenta hatching on purpose, and init excludes the copy from its own rules
ignore.packages/undrift/tests/**: gate test fixtures: violations planted on purpose, evasion attempts, a clean control, and extracts of other design systems, all kept exactly as they are
ignore.apps/web/app/globals.css: wiring only: imports, @source paths, the two font face slots pointed at the next/font variables, and the Fumadocs colour variables mapped onto token roles. The docs search dialog's box-shadow is set to the --shadow-dialog role, because Plinth's black is switched off. It declares no font stack, no colour and no length of its own
ignore.packages/components/tailwind.css: token wiring plus everything it sets of its own, each written out here in full, property and value together. The bg-gap-hatch utility is the gap marker's stripe pattern: background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, color-mix(in oklch, --theme(--color-gap-border) 10%, transparent) 0 7px, transparent 7px 14px). The .font-mono rule aligns figures: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. The grid-auto-* utilities, one for each rung of the grid minimum, set grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(var(--layout-grid-min-*), 1fr)). The body base rule sets font-family: var(--font-sans). The one at-rule that is not wiring is @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)). The @theme block that switches off Tailwind's built-in colours sets each of these to initial: --color-red-*: initial, --color-orange-*: initial, --color-amber-*: initial, --color-yellow-*: initial, --color-lime-*: initial, --color-green-*: initial, --color-emerald-*: initial, --color-teal-*: initial, --color-cyan-*: initial, --color-sky-*: initial, --color-blue-*: initial, --color-indigo-*: initial, --color-violet-*: initial, --color-purple-*: initial, --color-fuchsia-*: initial, --color-pink-*: initial, --color-rose-*: initial, --color-slate-*: initial, --color-gray-*: initial, --color-zinc-*: initial, --color-neutral-*: initial, --color-stone-*: initial, --color-mauve-*: initial, --color-olive-*: initial, --color-mist-*: initial, --color-taupe-*: initial, --color-white: initial, --color-black: initial. Everything else is imports, @source, @layer, @utility and @theme mappings onto existing variables
